provider: EVEO Object Storage S3 (Brazil) — the only zero-egress S3 endpoint found in Latin America

free_tier.stated: R$0.05/GB/month, billed on stored GB only; buckets up to 5 PB, no provisioning. Positioned as «Armazenamento sem taxas de download (egress) ou API».

egress.terms: ZERO, stated as the product's entire pitch: «Zero Egress e API … a saída é gratuita, operações PUT, GET, LIST não pesam na fatura» (egress is free; PUT/GET/LIST operations do not weigh on the invoice). Also «paga apenas pelo GB armazenado … e acessa o que é seu sem taxas de pedágio». No retrieval fee. WORM immutability native.

tooling: S3-compatible with SigV4 presigned URLs — so it can sit behind Cloudflare the same way as any S3 store. rclone `s3`, restic, Veeam. Two-region replication inside Brazil, Tier III datacentres.
chaining: Pure per-GB, so 5 TB and 20 TB cost the same per TB. No bucket cap below 5 PB.
limits_note: Brazil-only geography — the same intercontinental-latency objection as Rollin Host for the hot set, though as an archive tier it is fine. The R$0.05/GB figure is the advertised rate and no volume staircase is published, so there may be no discount at 20 TB; ask. Enterprise sales motion («Simule seu Storage», «Solicite uma proposta») rather than self-serve checkout.
reliability_note: Enterprise-oriented Brazilian provider with Tier III DCs and two-region replication; no independent price/performance benchmark located. The zero-egress claim is on the vendor's own page and uncontradicted, but there is no published price list PDF to cross-check the R$0.05 number against, so confidence on the exact rate is medium even though confidence on the egress policy is high.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
